sources.title: MACL airport traffic, official Maldives Datathon 2026 release v1.0
sources.publisher: MACL; distributed by Maldives Bureau of Statistics
sources.timezone: Not stated in supplied metadata; source clock values retained
sources.licenseStatus: Datathon participant dataset; archive has no explicit licence

quality.date_format: M/D/YYYY; supplied metadata incorrectly specifies YYYY-MM-DD
quality.cancellation_status: Not supplied; movement records are not a cancellation series

limitations: Historical airport activity is not current flight status, a timetable, unique travellers, bus mode share or local ground-transport demand.
The source does not identify the clock timezone or provide a named airport/route code lookup. No island route, domestic sector or UTC conversion is inferred.

Hourly rows use each arrival/departure event's own date and actual time. Missing, malformed and outside-period event dates are excluded; missing/malformed times are excluded from hourly rows but retained in monthly rows when the date is valid.
1970 arrival dates are treated as invalid sentinels. The one 2011 arrival is outside the reviewed 2012–July 2026 reference period. No dates are borrowed across events.
No turnaround or flight duration is inferred from the paired event dates. Negative and multi-day date differences have not been repaired.
Five repeated records excluding their unique ID remain included because the archive does not establish whether these represent distinct events.
Passengers sum adults, children and infants for the selected event. Transit counts are not added to arrival/departure passengers. Counts are movements.
Observed dates count only dates with source records in that group; absent groups are not manufactured as zero service. 2026 covers January–July only.
Keep this source separate from existing CAA/MBS totals: coverage has not been reconciled, and annual, monthly, hourly and cohort totals overlap.
